summary: A Human Resources Business Partner with extensive experience aligning HR strategy with business strategy for assigned business groups.

experience.title: HR Manager/Business Partner
responsibilities: Point of contact for multiple business groups of 400+ employees across Finance, Legal, IT, Manufacturing, Marketing, and Service.
Partnered with senior leadership on workforce planning, talent management, change management, and organizational capability building.
Resolved employee relations issues, including investigations, terminations, and day‑to‑day concerns.
Coached managers and employees on performance management, training, and development.
Facilitated annual calibration, salary planning, and talent reviews.
Collaborated with Talent Acquisition to drive recruitment strategies and requisition approvals.
Implemented retention initiatives and addressed skill gaps.
Designed and executed HR plans aligned with corporate and business unit direction.
Managed organizational change initiatives such as reorganizations and reductions in force.
Ensured compliance with legal requirements across diverse HR areas.

experience.title: Senior Human Resources Generalist
responsibilities: Managed 50+ open requisitions across exempt and non‑exempt positions.
Handled employee relations issues, including performance, harassment, investigations, and terminations.
Administered benefits, compensation, and tracked leave of absence.
Filed and monitored Workers' Compensation claims and OSHA reporting.
Supported recruiting functions and maintained vendor relationships.
Communicated workforce updates and morale issues to executive leadership.

experience.title: Associate Human Resources Representative
responsibilities: Administered benefit programs for 800 employees, including Flexible Benefits, 401(k), and COBRA.
Managed employee relations for a client group of 100 employees.
Conducted weekly new hire orientation for all employees.
Developed and promoted employee events and award programs.
Created and managed a Wellness Program.
Processed leave of absence and supported recruiting efforts.
